software.label: Software Development & Automation
software.instruction: Define behavior, inspect targeted code, make a focused change, and run the smallest relevant test.

research.label: Research Activities
research.instruction: Define the research question, evidence standard, uncertainty, and one appropriate research mode.

book-writing.label: Book Writing
book-writing.instruction: Resolve the book contract, evidence, reader-facing manuscript, and handoff boundaries without treating established knowledge as a new research contribution.

presentation.label: Presentation
presentation.instruction: Define audience, occasion, duration, delivery mode, intended action, core message, and storyline before production.

content-analysis.label: Content Analysis
content-analysis.instruction: Define the corpus, unit of analysis, coding frame, evidence trail, and interpretation boundary.

data-analytics.label: Data Analytics
data-analytics.instruction: Validate the data and metric definitions before analysis, visualization, and decision implications.

education.label: Course Material Development
education.instruction: Align learner context, observable outcomes, activity, feedback, and assessment.

governance.label: Educational Policy Development
governance.instruction: Identify authority, stakeholders, evidence, options, feasibility, implementation, and review gate.

operations.label: Administrative & Professional Operations
operations.instruction: Verify requirement, deadline, status, evidence, owner, next action, and proof of completion.

general.label: General / Technical Other
general.instruction: Clarify the concrete requested outcome and apply only task-relevant constraints.

deliverables.policy: policy, governance decision, or institutional proposal
deliverables.course-material: lesson, syllabus, exercise, assessment, or teaching asset
deliverables.document: formal document, correspondence, dossier, or report

methods.content-analysis: systematic coding or interpretation of a corpus
methods.data-analytics: data validation, metrics, statistics, or visualization
methods.web-development: browser, frontend, backend web API, accessibility, or web performance
methods.research-synthesis: literature, external evidence, or source synthesis
methods.strategy-advisory: option comparison, advising, or direction setting
